name: Preferred Stock / Fixed-Income Equities

yield.notes: Higher yield than common stock but subordinate to bonds in bankruptcy. Fixed dividend but callable.

flags: Callable: issuer can redeem at par if rates drop
Rate-sensitive: price drops when rates rise

prerequisites: Brokerage account with access to preferred stock trading
startup_checklist: Research preferred stock screeners on Schwab or Fidelity
Focus on investment-grade issuers (bank preferreds, utility preferreds)
Check call date and call price before buying at premium
Diversify across at least 5 issuers to reduce single-company risk
Track ex-dividend dates for income planning
failure_modes: Purchased at premium; called at par — capital loss
kill_criteria: Issuer credit rating downgrade to below investment grade
sources_note: Yield ranges from preferred stock market data.
